title: Building an AppSec Program
markdown:
**Building an AppSec program** answers the interview scenario: *"You're the first security hire at a 200-person startup-what do you do in the first 90 days?"* Success requires **charter**, **asset inventory**, **risk-based prioritization**, **developer partnerships**, **tooling with low noise**, and **measurable outcomes**-not buying every scanner on day one.

This guide follows the **[Content Mastery Framework](../Interview%20Preparation/Content%20Mastery%20Framework.md)**.

children.title: Misconceptions
"Buy SAST/DAST day one."
children.markdown: **Wrong.** **Inventory and quick wins** first; tools without **tuning owners** become shelfware.
children.notes: Wrong. Inventory and quick wins first; tools without tuning owners become shelfware.

children.title: "AppSec reviews every PR."
children.markdown: **Wrong.** **Automate** broad coverage; human review on **high-risk paths** and **tiers**.
children.notes: Wrong. Automate broad coverage; human review on high-risk paths and tiers.

children.title: "Compliance is the program."
children.markdown: **Wrong.** Compliance is **one input**; **exploitability and business risk** drive priorities.
children.notes: Wrong. Compliance is one input; exploitability and business risk drive priorities.

children.title: "Headcount before process."
children.markdown: **Wrong.** **Charter, intake, metrics** make the case for headcount with evidence.
children.notes: Wrong. Charter, intake, metrics make the case for headcount with evidence.

children.title: "Pen test once = program."
children.markdown: **Wrong.** Program is **continuous** SDLC integration, not annual audit.
children.notes: Wrong. Program is continuous SDLC integration, not annual audit.

children.title: "Developers are the enemy."
children.markdown: **Wrong.** **Partnership** model wins; punitive gates fail at scale.
children.notes: Wrong. Partnership model wins; punitive gates fail at scale.

children.title: Interview prompts
60-second answer
children.markdown:
**Q: You're the first AppSec hire-first 90 days?**

**A:** **Days 1-30:** asset/data inventory, incident history, secret scan + MFA quick wins, eng relationships. **Days 31-60:** risk tiers, CI SCA/secrets, threat modeling for Tier 1, security champions. **Days 61-90:** pilot release gate on one product, pen test/bounty pilot, metrics dashboard and roadmap. Partner with engineering-reduce risk without becoming a bottleneck.
children.notes:

Days 61-90: pilot release gate on one product, pen test/bounty pilot, metrics dashboard and roadmap. Partner with engineering-reduce risk without becoming a bottleneck.

children.markdown: **A:** **MTTR** for High+, **Critical in prod** trend, **% Tier-1** with threat models, **scanner signal ratio**, **repeat finding rate**, developer satisfaction with consult SLAs.
